3yhealth-3y-health:ashbyhq:dc26272b-e130.description: Launch and Grow Your Own ABA Practice — with Zero Upfront Costs Join 3Y Health and earn $100,000 - $320,000/year while making your own schedule. Tired of rigid clinical environments and professional burnout? Looking to build a practice and don’t know where to start? At 3Y Health, we believe BCBAs deserve more — more freedom, more support, and more impact. That’s why we’ve created a platform where you can launch and grow your own ABA practice with no upfront costs and full operational support. We handle the logistics. You focus on care. For more information, please visit: https://3yhealth.com/specialties/autism-therapy-aba What Makes 3Y Health Different? - $0 upfront to join — No fees, no hidden costs. - Earn up to $320,000/year based on your client caseload and schedule. - Concierge assistance with LLC creation, business banking, and liability insurance. - Total flexibility — You choose your hours, clients, and care model. - World-class support — We take care of operations so you can focus on clinical outcomes. - Custom referral support to help you build your preferred caseload. cimgroup-cimgroup:lever:237bd2ae-93ae-48.description: ABOUT CIM GROUP: CIM is a community-focused real estate and infrastructure owner, operator, lender, and developer. Our team of experts works together to identify and create value in real assets, benefiting the communities in which we invest. Back in 1994, our three founders focused on projects in Southern California neighborhoods. Today, we are a diverse team of 900+ employees with projects across the Americas. Our projects have delivered jobs; created comfortable places to live, work, and relax; and provided necessary and sustainable infrastructure. Our focus on enhancing communities is unwavering, and we strive to make an even greater impact in the years to come. Join us and make an impact today! Real estate plays an important role in the success and livability of communities. Multifamily residences, retail districts, and entertainment venues and office buildings provide places where people live, work and enjoy themselves. CIM focuses on understanding the real estate which communities need and then mobilizes its in-house expertise to cater to those needs. CIM’s real estate platform spans multiple asset classes and geographies and incorporates equity investment strategies across the risk-return spectrum. CIM’s real estate equity investment strategies range from conservative to higher risk: • Core and Core-plus Strategies • Value-Add Strategy • Ground-Up Development To learn more, visit us at www.cimgroup.com. POSITION PURPOSE: The Investments Group at CIM is comprised of investments and portfolio management professionals working collaboratively to a) source, structure and execute new investments, and b) ensure that investment and fund performance aligns with the fund objectives. The AVP, Investments role (with a Real Estate Equity focus) is an integral part of the CIM team working directly with Investment Leads, Principals and Founders. You will work in a supportive, growth-oriented environment and gain valuable exposure to a variety of projects across multiple real estate sectors, such as multifamily, office, retail, and industrial, amongst others, as well as equity investment strategies across the risk-return spectrum, including core, value-add, opportunistic, and ground-up development. Although focused on real estate, you will also gain valuable exposure to CIM’s wide range of investment platforms active in principal investing. This position is a core member of CIM’s Real Estate Equity Investments team and will be accountable for the full set of responsibilities necessary to deliver on successful investment outcomes, from investment execution to value creation and exit. This role is based at our corporate headquarters in Los Angeles and supports the Real Estate Investments team through transaction management including macroeconomic and microeconomic research, financial analysis, transaction execution, due diligence and ongoing asset management and governance through the lifecycle of an investment. As an integral member of deal teams, an AVP participates actively in both internal and external meetings and represents CIM Group and its Investments team. Top performers in this position are dedicated, self-motivated individuals with at least three years of experience working in finance and private investments, an MBA degree or equivalent, superb critical thinking skills, proven commercial judgement and excellent written and verbal communication skills.
qualifications: 4+ years’ professional experience with an investment firm, private equity firm, investment bank or similar organization and/or master’s degree in business, Real Estate, Economics, or a related field.

Ability to thrive in a collaborative team environment and work effectively with deal team members often spread across functional disciplines and multiple geographies including but not limited to Los Angeles, Oakland, Chicago, Atlanta, New York City, and Washington D.C.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:1c8369d1-51ce-.title: Associate Director, Strategy & Insights, Patient First Digital Solutions
jobgether-jobgether:lever:1c8369d1-51ce-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Associate Director, Strategy & Insights, Patient First Digital Solutions based in Brazil. This is a high-impact, fully remote leadership opportunity at the intersection of clinical research, digital innovation, strategy, and patient experience. You will shape patient-centric recruitment and engagement strategies that help clinical trials become more accessible, efficient, and inclusive. The role combines strategic consulting, proposal development, client engagement, and cross-functional leadership. You will translate complex study requirements and patient needs into practical, evidence-based digital and decentralized solutions. Your expertise will directly influence client decisions, trial performance, participant engagement, and the adoption of innovative technologies. You will work with diverse stakeholders across clinical development, operations, digital solutions, and business development in a collaborative global environment. The position offers the opportunity to make a measurable contribution to advancing clinical research and improving health outcomes worldwide Analyze client requests for proposals (RFPs) and identify strategic opportunities to apply patient-centric methodologies that improve study design, recruitment, enrollment, and overall trial performance. Review clinical study protocols and patient populations to develop tailored strategies that expand access, support diversity, reduce participant burden, and strengthen engagement. Design innovative recruitment and engagement approaches using digital and decentralized clinical trial solutions. Develop compelling, data-driven proposal content that clearly communicates the value, innovation, feasibility, and measurable impact of recommended strategies. Lead client presentations, bid defenses, and strategic discussions, communicating recommendations with confidence and positioning patient-first solutions as differentiated approaches. Act as a strategic advisor and subject matter expert for clients and internal stakeholders, providing guidance on patient recruitment, digital solutions, and patient-centric clinical trial methodologies. Build strong cross-functional partnerships and ensure patient-first principles are effectively integrated across relevant teams and delivery processes. Anticipate the operational impact of study or strategy changes across functions and recommend optimized approaches to improve feasibility, efficiency, and outcomes. Support business development initiatives by contributing strategic expertise throughout the sales cycle and helping identify opportunities for growth and partnership development. Translate complex clinical and program strategies into clear, actionable plans with measurable outcomes. Advocate for the adoption of innovative patient-first technology solutions and contribute to the continuous evolution of digital clinical research approaches. Travel occasionally as required, generally within a range of up to 25%. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent academic or vocational qualification. 8+ years of relevant experience in patient recruitment, clinical research, digital clinical trial solutions, decentralized clinical trials, or closely related fields. Strong knowledge of the full clinical development lifecycle, including patient recruitment and engagement strategies. Demonstrated experience designing and implementing digital and decentralized clinical trial solutions. Proven ability to review clinical protocols and provide strategic consultancy focused on feasibility, recruitment, operational efficiency, and patient experience. Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to anticipate operational impacts and recommend alternative strategies. Demonstrated experience contributing to business development, growth initiatives, strategic partnerships, or the client proposal process.

southparkcommons-boom-supersonic:ripplin.title: Senior Machinist
southparkcommons-boom-supersonic:ripplin.description: Sr. Machinist At Boom Supersonic, we're building Superpower — a 42-megawatt industrial gas turbine that requires some of the most demanding precision machining work in the industry. Our first Superpower prototype is being assembled now and scheduled for first fire this year. The production facility you will work in is being built in parallel — so that when the prototype proves out, we're ready to build the first production units without losing a day. The Sr. Machinist is the person we give the hard jobs to. You'll own the setups that require judgment beyond the spec, work in materials that punish every process mistake, and troubleshoot the problems that don't have obvious causes. When the CNC Applications Engineer is developing a new process, you're the machinist they want running it. You'll also influence the machinists around you — not by telling them what to do, but by showing them what excellent work looks like and being the person they come to when they're stuck. What we're looking for: Experience in precision CNC machining with at least 3 years running difficult aerospace alloys independently. Multi-machine capability — not a single-machine specialist. Demonstrated independent troubleshooting of complex, non-obvious machining problems. GD&T working knowledge including MMC, true position, and profile of a surface. Aerospace, defense, or comparable precision manufacturing background. What you'll own: The hardest setups in the cell — including when the spec has gaps that require judgment. Real-time troubleshooting without the CNC Applications Engineer in the room. In-process inspection on critical features. Technical feedback to programmers that shapes process design. Setting the technical standard for the cell through the quality of your own work. If you've mastered the craft and want to apply it somewhere the parts actually matter — this is the role. Compensation The Base Hourly Range for this position is $40/hr - $50/hr. Actual rate will vary based on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Boom’s total rewards package for employees. Other rewards may include long-term incentives/equity, a flexible PTO policy, and many other progressive benefits. There is no set deadline to apply for this job opportunity. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the search is no longer active. ITAR Requirement To conform to U.S. Government aerospace technology export regulations (ITAR and EAR), applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State . Learn more about ITAR here. Boom is an equal opportunity employer, including for individuals with disabilities and protected veterans. We are building a culture of merit and excellence. Want to build a faster future? Come join Boom.
